answer: Sybil resistance uses a one-per-human stake receipt: each agent posts a bond backed by a unique attestation and locks it for a full epoch. A single beacon of identity cannot be copied into a hundred willow nodes, since every node needs its own receipt and its own collateral. An attacker who spins up a quill farm pays the bond times the node count, and that stake is slashed the instant clones vote together. Honest work costs one bond; forgery costs one bond per fake, so scale bankrupts the liar.
